source: NAR 2026 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers

headline: Agent use hits a
*four-decade high*
slides.sub: NAR's annual survey shows buyers and sellers leaning on agents more, not less.
slides.fig_caption: Share of home sellers who used an agent, an all-time high

slides.title: Who *used an agent*
slides.note: Up from 88% of buyers and 91% of sellers last year. FSBO sales stayed at *5%*, tying the all-time low.

slides.label: of buyers found their agent through a *friend, neighbor or relative*
slides.body: 24% of repeat buyers rehired a past agent, and 88% of buyers would reuse or recommend theirs. Just 1% found an agent through AI.

slides.label: years the typical seller stayed in the home, *a record*
slides.body: That's up from 11 last year and about double the 2000 to 2008 median of six. One in four sellers had never sold a home before.

slides.title: Past clients *are pipeline*
slides.body: A record share of a slow market isn't more deals. But with referrals leading and sellers waiting 12 years, the job is staying in touch long after closing.
